source: LED Connection Optimus installation manual, bracket R, DNC1 April 2024 (tools/guides/source)

steps.title: Install the back plate inside the pole with the top bolt, nut and washer.
Align the bottom holes in the luminaire and back plate with the closest hole in the pole, install the lower bolt, and tighten both bolts.
Hang the fixture on the bracket and tighten the M4×12 mm screws.
Connect the cable in the bracket holder to the municipal (supply) wire, as shown in the wiring diagram.
Tighten the cover screws and make a good waterproof seal.
